RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

An all-women panel choosing a woman over another woman tells you almost nothing about sex discrimination — both candidates were the same sex, so sex can't easily explain why one was preferred. Raising the panel's composition would likely read as grasping and damage your credibility on the points that actually matter.

Those points are: the unanswered request for written reasons (chase it in writing, citing the deadline in the recruitment policy or your right to an explanation), and whether "strong experience of digital media" was a stated criterion, weighted transparently, or introduced afterwards to justify a chosen candidate. If seven years' less experience was outweighed by a late-appearing criterion, that's your question — and age, not sex, is the discrimination angle worth examining.
